headline: Riyadh Aramco Building Sustains Minor Shrapnel Damage
deck: Falling shrapnel caused minor damage to an administrative Aramco building in Riyadh; no injuries or fatalities were reported.
body: An administrative building belonging to Saudi Aramco in Riyadh was subjected to an attempted attack. [E1]
Falling shrapnel caused minor damage to the building, with no injuries or fatalities reported. [E2]
Air defences intercepted and destroyed two ballistic missiles launched by the Houthi militia toward Riyadh. [E3]
On Oct. 27, the Saudi Press Agency said Saudi air defences had intercepted and destroyed three ballistic missiles launched toward the Eastern Province. [E4]
